- Received: USD 137,500 on 2027-04-30 (single incoming wire).
- NovaCloud invoices: INV-2027-004 EUR 100,000; INV-2027-005 EUR 25,000.

Suggested short-term steps (to be posted today as provisional entries):
1) Post suspense clearing to reflect cash received in USD while allocation is pending:
   - Dr Bank (USD) 137,500 — GL: BANK-1000
   - Cr Suspense Clearing (USD) 137,500 — GL: SUSP-3000
2) Create a suspense-applied AR mapping in the AR subledger (no invoice applied yet) to avoid aging distortions.
3) Once NovaCloud confirms how they want fees allocated, post the allocation plus FX revaluation to move amounts to AR invoices (EUR). For revaluation, use our month-end rate (EOD Apr 30) unless NovaCloud asks otherwise.

   - Cr AR - INV-2027-004 (EUR) 100,000 @ 1.12 => USD 112,000 — GL: AR-1200
   - Cr AR - INV-2027-005 (EUR) 25,000 @ 1.12 => USD 28,000 — GL: AR-1200
   - Dr FX Realized Loss/Gain (USD) 1,500 — GL: FX-RESERVE-3800 (to balance; exact figure to be calculated after confirming our bank's USD/EUR settled rate and fees)

Notes:
- We should not post revenue reversals here — revenue remains recognized against the invoices; this is purely cash allocation and FX impact. If INV-2027-005 remains unpaid after 60 days post-allocation we will escalate to revenue ops per policy.
- Marcus will compute the final FX realized P/L after receiving confirmation of net USD received (i.e., confirm whether USD 137,500 is net of all fees).

Action items: Marcus to post provisional suspense entry today; Rachel to confirm with NovaCloud on fee allocation; follow-up journal (clearance + FX P/L) to be posted when confirmation received.
